SELECT cp.category, w.status, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, sum(f.net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') AND s.store_id<>999
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-02'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS fiscal_period),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id<>900
    UNION ALL
    SELECT f.sale_date, p.sku, f.net_amount, f.standard_cost
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id=900 AND false
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 1 AS x

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, cp.category,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(n.net_sales-n.cost)/SUM(n.net_sales),1) AS gross_margin_pct,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(n.net_sales-n.cost)/SUM(n.net_sales),3) AS gm3, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales-n.cost),2) AS gm
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=6 AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 3

    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date, p.sku, p.category AS cat_then,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, p.category, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 'asis' basis, cp.category, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) ns, ROUND(100.0*SUM(n.net_sales-n.cost)/SUM(n.net_sales),2) gmp
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=6 GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'aswas', n.cat_then, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2), ROUND(100.0*SUM(n.net_sales-n.cost)/SUM(n.net_sales),2)
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=6 GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'control_total_all_cats', 'TOTAL', ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2), NULL
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=6
UNION ALL
SELECT 'rpt_daily_store_sales', 'TOTAL', ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales),2), NULL
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=6
ORDER BY 1,2
